title: Petition of Fall River Gas Company, pursuant to Section 14 of Chapter 164 of the General Laws for approval and authorization by the Department of Public Utilities to issue and sell not in excess of 250,000 shares of Common Stock, $.83-1/3 par value, pursuant to the Company's Share Owner Dividend Reinvestment and Stock Purchase Plan and to issue and sell on a negotiated basis additional First Mortgage Bonds (or other long term debt securities) in the aggregate principal amount of up to $8,000,000, to be sold at par; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15; and for such other actions as may be deemed necessary or appropriate in connection with the foregoing.
